description: This is a semi-automatic pistol, chambered in.45 ACP and accepting M1911 magazines.

variants.//: You can get 'em for over US$1K if you want.  This is a fairly cheap remake.
variants.description: The M1911 was the US Military standard-issue sidearm for most of the 20th Century.  It remains one of the most popular.45 pistols today.
An update to the original M1911, featuring an extended tang on the grip safety to prevent hammer bite as well as a shorter trigger for smaller hands.
